name: thesis

scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:services && npm run test:ui
scripts.besu:up: node scripts/ops/besu/generate.mjs --if-missing && node scripts/ops/besu/validate-config.mjs && node scripts/ops/besu/ensure-docker.mjs && node scripts/ops/besu/start.mjs
scripts.besu:down: docker compose -f networks/besu/docker-compose.yml down -v && node scripts/ops/besu/clean-data.mjs
scripts.demo:prepare: npm run besu:up && npm run institutional:deploy && npm run institutional:governance
scripts.demo:start: npm run demo:prepare && npm run demo:ui
scripts.demo:fresh: npm run besu:down && npm run besu:generate && npm run demo:prepare && npm run demo:ui
scripts.demo:reset: npm run besu:down && npm run besu:generate && npm run demo:prepare
scripts.institutional:deploy: node scripts/ops/besu/health.mjs --quick && npm run compile && node scripts/ops/deployment/deploy-stack.mjs
scripts.institutional:test: npm run institutional:deploy && npm run institutional:governance && npm run institutional:integration

description: Institutional cross-chain collateral and lending system for two permissioned Besu bank networks.
